name: File Complex Student Tax Return
description: Open StudioTax 2024 and create a new tax return for Farah Awan, a full-time student with multiple income sources. Read the scenario file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\TaxScenarios\scenario_farah_awan.txt for all data. This is a complex return requiring: (1) Personal information — name: Farah Awan, SIN: 375-678-909, DOB: September 8, 2000, marital status: Single, province: Ontario, address: 789 College Street Apt 12, Toronto ON M5T 1P7. Mark as full-time student. (2) Add T4 slip from Page Turner Bookstore — Box 14: $10,000 employment income, Box 16: $385 CPP, Box 18: $150 EI, Box 22: $0 tax deducted. (3) Enter T5007 social assistance payment of $14,000 from ODSP on Line 14500. (4) Add T4A slip for scholarship of $4,500 (Box 105) and a separate T4A for RESP educational assistance of $5,700 (Box 040). (5) Enter T2202 tuition fees of $6,000 total ($3,000 per semester) on Schedule 11. (6) Save the return as 'farah_awan.24t' in C:\Users\Docker\Documents\StudioTax.
